title: Add shadow restart ledger balance and live-nonexecution acceptance tests
description:
This is a verification-only task. Write real acceptance tests and an audit artifact for the phase p SHADOW implementation. Do not modify production code. If a defect is found, record it in the verification doc as a failing/open item rather than editing source files.

tests/integration/test_shadow_restart.py must use a temporary SQLite WAL database. It runs at least one named scenario (via mike_trade/shadow/scenarios.py) through a deterministic, fixed quote/bar sequence. The sequence must cover:
- buy fill
- partial fill
- stop arming
- trailing stop update
- stop-triggered or discretionary exit
- cash adjustment
- cooldown/loss-streak counter changes

The test then closes everything and reopens from the same database file in a fresh account/ledger/runner instance. It asserts that cash, positions, open orders, stop state, realized/unrealized P&L, per-symbol session entry counts, loss streaks and cooldown expiry are identical after the restart. It also asserts that starting cash is not re-applied and positions are not reset. Include a second scenario to prove that restart restores each scenario independently.

The file must also include live-nonexecution tests:
- With Alpaca trading client constructors/order submission patched to raise, and paper/live credential env vars poisoned, a full shadow run completes without any call to them.
- SHADOW ledgers reject PAPER/LIVE account IDs.
- All shadow fill and stop records are labeled estimated and not broker-confirmed, and carry simulator version and feed provenance.

docs/verification/phase_p_shadow.md must document: what was verified; the exact focused commands used to run these tests; their results; the simulator assumptions (quote side, latency, slippage, participation, stop trigger); the restart/isolation/nonexecution guarantees and evidence; any gaps or open defects; and the explicit statement that shadow results are estimates, not broker-confirmed, and imply no profitability claim.

Before editing, inspect:
- mike_trade/brokers/shadow/account.py, mike_trade/brokers/shadow/ledger.py, mike_trade/brokers/shadow/fills.py, mike_trade/brokers/shadow/stops.py
- mike_trade/shadow/scenarios.py
- tests/unit/test_shadow_account.py, tests/unit/test_shadow_fills.py, tests/unit/test_shadow_stops.py, tests/integration/test_shadow_isolation.py
- the existing Alpaca adapter module(s) under mike_trade/brokers/ (only to identify the symbols to patch, not to edit them)
acceptance_criteria: tests/integration/test_shadow_restart.py exists and passes when run alone, using only a temporary database and deterministic fixtures
After the restart, cash, positions, open orders, stop state, realized/unrealized P&L, session entry counts, loss streaks and cooldown expiry exactly equal their pre-restart Decimal/UTC values
The restart test proves starting cash is not re-applied and positions are not reset, for at least two independent scenarios
The live-nonexecution test fails if any Alpaca trading client constructor or order-submission path is invoked during a full shadow run, and it passes with the current implementation
The test asserts that SHADOW ledgers reject PAPER/LIVE account identifiers
The test asserts that every shadow fill/stop record is estimated=True and broker_confirmed=False and carries simulator version and provenance
docs/verification/phase_p_shadow.md exists and lists the exact commands run, results, simulator assumptions, guarantees, open gaps, and the estimated/no-profitability-claim statement
No production source files are modified by this task
forbidden_changes: modify files outside allowed_write_paths, including any mike_trade/ production source
change PLAN_SKELETON.json or other planning artifacts
use real broker credentials or network access in tests
create live or paper broker orders
run broad test suites, large backtests, or paid data acquisition
